Each floating ingredient has a glowing neon label tag on a wire, uppercase bold condensed font, backlit: "{argument name="ingredient 1" default="80/20 CHUCK"}", "{argument name="ingredient 2" default="DOUBLE SMASH"}", "{argument name="ingredient 3" default="AMERICAN MELT"}", "BRIOCHE CROWN", "BRINE PICKLE", "HOUSE SAUCE". Dish name in large neon sign typography at top: "THE SMASH". Subtitle: "engineered at 3am". Mood: street food energy at full volume, cinematic, electric. Style ref: Blade Runner 2049 meets hyperreal CGI food campaign. 4K, ultra sharp, chromatic aberration on edges, craveable.
translatedContent: 超写实 Smash Burger 悬浮在纯黑背景中，被霓虹电光黄和深红色的底光及轮廓光戏剧性地照亮。食材分离并悬浮在半空中，呈现出松散的对角线级联状，而非堆叠在一起，仿佛在制作过程中被定格的动态瞬间。布里欧修面包顶层翻滚着，芝麻像火花一样四散；两块 Smash 肉饼旋转着，边缘呈现出酥脆的蕾丝状，在霓虹热光下闪烁；一片美国芝士悬浮在半融化状态，捕捉着如熔金般的光泽；酸黄瓜像卫星一样环绕；焦糖洋葱深邃而闪亮地漂浮着；自制酱料丝带在慢动作中划出琥珀色的弧线。每一处纹理都超写实且令人垂涎。每个悬浮的食材上都挂着一个带有电线的发光霓虹标签，采用大写粗体压缩字体，背光显示："{argument name="ingredient 1" default="80/20 CHUCK"}", "{argument name="ingredient 2" default="DOUBLE SMASH"}", "{argument name="ingredient 3" default="AMERICAN MELT"}", "BRIOCHE CROWN", "BRINE PICKLE", "HOUSE SAUCE"。顶部以大型霓虹灯排版显示菜名："THE SMASH"。副标题："engineered at 3am"。氛围：街头美食能量全开，电影感，电子风。风格参考：《银翼杀手 2049》与超写实 CGI 食品广告的结合。4K 分辨率，超清晰，边缘带有色差效果，令人垂涎。

description: 这是一个为 Nano Banana 2 设计的超写实提示词，旨在生成一张极具电影质感的时尚编辑人像。画面中 Sabrina Carpenter 赤脚坐在郁郁葱葱花园里的质朴石盆边缘，与一尊石质小天使雕像互动，沐浴在温暖的琥珀色晨光中。
content:
"A photorealistic, highly stylized cinematic lifestyle editorial portrait of {argument name="subject name" default="Sabrina Carpenter"} sitting casually barefoot on the edge of a rustic stone basin in a lush garden during the early morning. She is wearing an oversized, light yellow button-down collared shirt, worn loosely and wide open at the front, with partially rolled-up sleeves and her bare legs visible. Her blonde hair is styled in a messy high bun with delicate, loose strands beautifully framing her face. She has subtle natural makeup, dark burgundy nail polish, a thin delicate necklace with a small dark pendant, and small stud earrings.
Her pose is relaxed and slightly surreal: her right leg is bent with the knee raised, while her left arm wraps around a weathered, greenish stone cherub statue of a similar size to her. Her left hand brings a black coffee cup to her lips, and she wears a soft, gently amused expression. Her right hand rests near her feet, loosely holding the handle of a small, vintage lilac ceramic pitcher decorated with painted roses and green leaves.
The whimsical, intimate scene is bathed in warm, golden amber sunrise light filtering through the trees, creating a soft rim light on her hair and the statue. A soft, flattering directional light casts delicate natural shadows on her face and shirt. The background features beautifully blurred earthy green foliage, trees, a subtle glimpse of a metal fence, and pink and deep red flowers, resulting in a stunning soft bokeh effect. Shot as a medium portrait from an eye-level angle using a telephoto lens (85mm) for a shallow depth of field. Professional lighting, 8K resolution, sharp focus on her face and the coffee cup, realistic textures, vintage aesthetic. --ar 9:16"
translatedContent:
"一张超写实、极具电影质感的时尚编辑人像，画面中 {argument name="subject name" default="Sabrina Carpenter"} 在清晨时分赤脚随意地坐在郁郁葱葱花园里的质朴石盆边缘。她穿着一件超大号的浅黄色翻领衬衫，领口敞开，袖子半卷，露出双腿。金色的头发梳成凌乱的高丸子头，几缕细碎的发丝柔美地修饰着脸庞。妆容自然精致，涂着深酒红色指甲油，佩戴一条带有小巧深色吊坠的精致项链和一对小耳钉。
她的姿态放松且略带超现实感：右腿弯曲，膝盖抬起，左臂环抱着一尊与她体型相当、风化且泛着绿意的石质小天使雕像。她左手拿着一杯黑咖啡凑近唇边，表情柔和而带着一丝笑意。右手放在脚边，松松地握着一个复古淡紫色陶瓷水罐的把手，水罐上绘有玫瑰和绿叶图案。
这个奇幻而亲密的场景沐浴在温暖的琥珀色晨光中，阳光透过树木洒下，在她的头发和雕像边缘勾勒出柔和的轮廓光。柔和且修饰脸型的定向光在她的脸部和衬衫上投下细腻的自然阴影。背景是虚化得极美的泥土色绿植、树木、隐约可见的金属栅栏以及粉色和深红色的花朵，呈现出令人惊艳的柔焦效果。采用中景人像构图，平视角度拍摄，使用 85mm 长焦镜头以获得浅景深效果。专业布光，8K 分辨率，面部和咖啡杯焦点清晰，纹理真实，复古美学。 --ar 9:16"

title: 超清写实真人与风格化 3D 漫画形象构图提示词
description: 一份为 Gemini Nano Banana 2 编写的详细提示词，旨在生成一张包含真人主体及其风格化 3D 漫画形象的单帧图像，强调真人主体严格的身份一致性，并为漫画形象赋予夸张的 Pixar/Disney 风格，同时包含特定的构图与光影要求。
content:
Proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, and all recognizable features. Do not alter or stylize the real face.
Composition & Framing:

Full-body vertical shot with a clean, centered layout. The real subject stands on the right, and the caricature stands on the left at approximately 50–60% of the real subject’s height. The real subject casually rests one elbow on the caricature’s oversized head, creating a natural, playful interaction.
Real Subject (Photographic):

Ultra-realistic rendering with natural skin texture and fine detail. Expression is warm, relaxed, and confident.
Pose & Style (IMPORTANT):

The subject stands in a slightly cool, stylish posture — relaxed stance with subtle asymmetry (one leg slightly forward or weight shifted), shoulders loose, not stiff. The hand resting on the caricature should feel effortless and natural.
Clothing (Match Reference):

{argument name="clothing" default="Gray crewneck sweater (fine knit texture, ribbed cuffs/hem), classic blue jeans (straight fit), and clean white sneakers"}. Keep textures realistic and clearly visible.
3D Caricature (Stylized Version):

Pixar/Disney-inspired 3D style with exaggerated proportions — large expressive head and smaller body. The height should be noticeably shorter, around the real subject's waist level.
Facial features must remain recognizable but enhanced — larger eyes, softer forms, slightly amplified smile.
Emotion & Body Movement (IMPORTANT):

Expression is more playful and animated than the real subject

Eyes brighter and more expressive, smile slightly exaggerated
Body posture must NOT be stiff — use a natural, lively stance

Add subtle movement according to the real subject's personality

Pose should feel like a living, animated character, not a rigid figurine
Clothing:

Exact 1:1 stylized recreation of the real subject’s outfit with soft 3D textures.
Lighting & Environment:

Soft, diffused studio lighting from the upper-left, creating smooth highlights and gentle shadows. Clean light-gray gradient seamless background(lighter in the inner areas).
Output Style:

Ultra-clean, cinematic, high-detail render with strong contrast between realistic human and stylized 3D character. Both subjects grounded with soft natural shadows.
translatedContent:
比例、肤色、发型及所有可识别特征。请勿对真实面部进行任何修改或风格化处理。
构图与取景：

全身垂直构图，布局简洁居中。真人主体位于右侧，漫画形象位于左侧，高度约为真人主体的 50%–60%。真人主体的一只手肘自然地搭在漫画形象的大头上，营造出自然、俏皮的互动感。
真人主体（摄影级）：

超写实渲染，呈现自然的皮肤纹理与细腻细节。表情温暖、放松且自信。
姿势与风格（重要）：

主体呈现出一种略带酷感的时尚姿态——站姿放松，带有微妙的不对称感（一条腿略微靠前或重心偏移），肩膀自然下垂，不僵硬。搭在漫画形象上的手应感觉轻松自然。
服装（匹配参考）：

{argument name="clothing" default="灰色圆领毛衣（细针织纹理，罗纹袖口/下摆）、经典蓝色牛仔裤（直筒版型）以及干净的白色运动鞋"}。保持纹理真实且清晰可见。
3D 漫画形象（风格化版本）：

Pixar/Disney 风格的 3D 设计，采用夸张的比例——大而富有表现力的头部与较小的身体。高度应明显更矮，大约在真人主体的腰部位置。
面部特征必须保持可识别性但有所增强——眼睛更大、轮廓更柔和、笑容略微夸张。
情感与肢体动作（重要）：

表情比真人主体更俏皮、更生动

眼睛更明亮、更具表现力，笑容略显夸张
身体姿态绝不能僵硬——使用自然、活泼的站姿

根据真人主体的个性添加微妙的动作

姿势应感觉像是一个鲜活的动画角色，而非僵硬的玩偶
服装：

真人主体服装的 1:1 风格化还原，带有柔和的 3D 纹理。
光影与环境：

来自左上方的柔和漫射摄影棚灯光，营造出平滑的高光和柔和的阴影。干净的浅灰色渐变无缝背景（内部区域较亮）。
输出风格：

超清、电影感、高细节渲染，在写实真人与风格化 3D 角色之间形成强烈对比。两个主体均需带有柔和的自然阴影，以确保落地感。

title: 在 Kling 3.0 Omni 中使用 Nano Banana Pro 图像参考进行视频生成
description: 这条推文介绍了如何使用由 Nano Banana Pro 生成的单张图像作为参考，通过 Kling 3.0 Omni 的“图像/主体参考”功能生成五个视频片段。用于初始图像和后续视频生成的提示词描述了一位身穿蓝色格子制服的金色头发女孩走在林荫道上的场景。
content: 木漏れ日が落ちる並木道と澄み渡る青空を背景に、青いチェックの制服と黒い厚底シューズを身に着けた金髪の少女が軽快に歩く。立ち止まって肩越しに振り返るはにかんだ笑顔、スカートの裾を持ってのターン、黒いスクールバッグを胸に抱きしめて空を見上げる仕草を経て、最後はカメラに満面の笑みで手を振り、光の中へと駆け出していく。ポップで爽やかな雰囲気とダイナミックなカメラワークが特徴の映像。
translatedContent: 一位身穿蓝色格子制服、脚蹬黑色厚底鞋的金色头发女孩，轻盈地走在林荫道上，阳光透过树叶洒下，天空湛蓝清澈。场景展现了她停下脚步回眸羞涩一笑、提着裙摆转身、将黑色书包抱在胸前抬头望天，最后对着镜头灿烂挥手并跑向光影深处的画面。视频呈现出清新灵动的氛围，并采用了动态镜头拍摄。

title: 三联画混合媒介时尚构图
description: 这是为 Google Gemini Nano Banana Pro 编写的提示词，旨在创作一张高分辨率、照片级逼真的三联画构图，将女性形象融入抽象的混合媒介拼贴背景中，并详细描述了每个画面的姿势、服装和艺术风格。
content:
A high-resolution, photorealistic three-panel composition featuring a woman with long, voluminous wavy brown hair and elegant features, integrated into an abstract mixed-media collage background.
Panel Layout:

Left Panel (Vertical, full height):

A tall portrait of the woman looking upwards at a dramatic angle, wearing a mustard yellow turtleneck. Cinematic lighting highlights her face and hair, with strong shadows and depth.
Top Right Panel (Square):

A close-up angled side profile, soft gaze to the right, wearing a black modern blazer with minimal jewelry. Expression is calm and confident.
Bottom Right Panel (Square):

A slightly top-down perspective, playful yet elegant pose, wearing a white textured dress, subtle smile, natural lighting.
Art Style & Background (applies to all panels):

The image is layered with an abstract mixed-media collage background incorporating geometric shapes like circles and rectangles in ochre, burnt orange, and charcoal grey. Include textural elements such as vintage parchment paper, blueprint-style technical sketches, and subtle floral etchings. Use a flat graphic design overlay that partially blends into each outfit, seamlessly merging the 3D subject with 2D modernist art.
Overall Style:

Cinematic lighting, fine art photography aesthetic, ultra-detailed, 8K resolution, modern editorial fashion magazine layout.
translatedContent:
一张高分辨率、照片级逼真的三联画构图，主角是一位留着蓬松棕色长波浪卷发、五官精致的女性，她被融入到抽象的混合媒介拼贴背景中。

画面布局：

左侧画面（垂直，全高）：

一张女性仰视的全身肖像，角度极具戏剧性，身穿芥末黄高领毛衣。电影级灯光突显了她的面部和发丝，具有强烈的阴影和深度感。

右上画面（正方形）：

一张侧面特写，目光柔和地看向右侧，身穿现代黑色西装外套，佩戴极简首饰。表情冷静且自信。

右下画面（正方形）：

略带俯视的视角，姿势俏皮而优雅，身穿白色质感连衣裙，面带浅笑，自然光照明。

艺术风格与背景（适用于所有画面）：

图像叠加了抽象的混合媒介拼贴背景，融入了赭石色、焦橙色和炭灰色的圆形与矩形等几何形状。包含复古羊皮纸、蓝图风格技术草图和精致花卉蚀刻等纹理元素。使用平面图形设计覆盖层，使其部分融入每套服装，将 3D 主体与 2D 现代主义艺术无缝融合。

整体风格：

电影级灯光，美术摄影美学，超精细，8K 分辨率，现代时尚杂志排版。

title: Starbucks Frappuccino 高端摄影棚广告视觉设计
description: 这是一份针对 Nano Banana Pro 的详细提示词，旨在引导其担任资深艺术总监，为 Starbucks Frappuccino 创作一张照片级逼真的 CGI 摄影棚广告视觉图。提示词涵盖了画布尺寸、背景颜色、水印图案、Logo 位置、产品摆放、光照条件及技术规格，旨在营造高端奢侈品牌的视觉美感。
content:
Act as a senior art director and studio photographer for high-end advertising campaigns and e-commerce.

Format & Canvas
Vertical 9 :16. Background: {argument name="background color" default="warm off-white (# F4EFE6)"} or a neutral tone characteristic of the brand, with no visible shadows.

Background Pattern
Apply the brand’s signature motif as a large, tone-on-tone watermark (10–18% opacity). Motif size should be 15–25% of the canvas width, with a soft, slightly embossed feel.

Logo Placement
Position the Starbucks logo centered in the upper third. Width: 40–50% of the canvas. Use a flat, two-dimensional rendering in official brand colors.
Place the wordmark below the logo in spaced uppercase letters, matching the logo color. Wordmark height: approximately 60% of the logo height.

Product Placement
Photorealistic Starbucks frappuccino with full material fidelity (cup, lid, straw, textures, branding details).
Position: bottom right, angled at 25–35°. Cropped at 60–75%, occupying 55–65% of the canvas.
Use soft contact shadows (8–12% opacity), with no harsh shadows.

Lighting
Soft, directional daylight (5500–6000K). Key light from top left, fill from the right.
Minimal contrast (1.2–1.5:1), with global illumination for subtle light bounce.
No edge highlights; reflections only on metallic elements. Avoid hard shadows.

Typography & Finishing
At the bottom: a thin horizontal line (1 px, 80% width, in brand color).
Below it: microcopy ({argument name="microcopy text" default="social link or collection tag"}) in a clean sans-serif font, aligned with the context.

Technical Specifications
Photorealistic CGI (KeyShot/Octane style), 9: 16, ultra-high detail, f/16 depth of field, sharp edges, neutral color accuracy, slightly warm background, no environmental reflections.
Mood reference: official visuals from Louis Vuitton / Bottega Veneta / Celine.
translatedContent:
请担任高端广告活动及电子商务领域的资深艺术总监和摄影棚摄影师。

格式与画布
比例 9 : 16。背景：{argument name="background color" default="暖米白色 (# F4EFE6)"} 或品牌特有的中性色调，无可见阴影。

背景图案
应用品牌标志性图案作为大尺寸、同色系的水印（不透明度 10–18%）。图案尺寸应为画布宽度的 15–25%，带有柔和、轻微的浮雕感。

Logo 位置
将 Starbucks Logo 置于上方三分之一处居中。宽度为画布的 40–50%。使用官方品牌色的平面二维渲染效果。
在 Logo 下方放置品牌文字标识，采用等间距大写字母，颜色与 Logo 保持一致。文字标识高度约为 Logo 高度的 60%。

产品摆放
照片级逼真的 Starbucks Frappuccino，具备完整的材质还原度（杯身、杯盖、吸管、纹理、品牌细节）。
位置：右下角，呈 25–35° 倾斜。裁剪比例为 60–75%，占据画布的 55–65%。
使用柔和的接触阴影（不透明度 8–12%），避免生硬的阴影。

光照
柔和的定向日光（5500–6000K）。主光来自左上方，补光来自右侧。
对比度极低（1.2–1.5:1），采用全局光照以实现微妙的光线反射。
无边缘高光；仅在金属元素上有反射。避免硬阴影。

排版与修饰
底部：一条细水平线（1 px，宽度为 80%，品牌色）。
下方：微文案（{argument name="microcopy text" default="社交链接或系列标签"}），使用简洁的无衬线字体，与语境对齐。

技术规格
照片级逼真 CGI（KeyShot/Octane 风格），9 : 16，超高细节，f/16 景深，边缘锐利，中性色彩准确度，背景略带暖色，无环境反射。
风格参考：Louis Vuitton / Bottega Veneta / Celine 的官方视觉风格。

title: 电影级微距玩具摄影：冲锋的军队
description: 这是一个使用 Nano Banana 生成电影级微距玩具摄影场景的详细提示词，描绘了数十个豆子大小的相同角色在暴雨中以军事阵型向前冲锋，并由一名骑着奇幻坐骑的指挥官带领。该提示词包含了关于相似度完整性、场景结构、运动动态、摄像机视角和光影原则的广泛约束。
content:
A cinematic macro toy-photography scene of dozens of identical bean-sized instances of the uploaded reference character charging forward through a violent rainstorm in a partially broken military formation, led by a commanding figure riding a fantastic mount deeper in the frame. ar 16:9
🧬 Likeness Integrity (CRITICAL)
All instances must preserve exactly:

• proportions

• eye shape, spacing, stylization

• silhouette

• material identity
No redesign. No added features. No facial changes.

All soldiers are identical instances of the same character.
⚔️ Scene Concept & Motion Structure
The army transitions from formation into full charge:
• front rows breaking into aggressive motion

• mid rows reacting milliseconds later

• deeper rows still partially aligned
Motion spreads like a wave through the army
Each unit runs with controlled variation:
• different stride timing and body angles

• no identical poses

• all movement directed forward
Weapons:
• each unit carries an oversized medieval-style weapon

• designs vary but follow a unified visual language

• subtle controlled glow, never overpowering

• must not obscure character identity
🐉 Leader & Mount (COMMAND LAYER)
A commanding leader appears deeper in the frame, elevated above the formation:
• positioned off-center along a rule-of-thirds axis

• partially silhouetted through rain and haze

• clearly distinct from the soldiers through scale and placement
Mount Design Logic (CRITICAL):
• derived from the character’s material and world language

• no literal cloning or costume mimicry

• subtle harmony in form, texture, and accents
Pose:
• mount in forward surge, cutting through rain

• leader stable and controlled, not exaggerated

• presence communicates authority, not motion chaos
The leader has already moved.

The army is catching up.
🪂 Foreground Hero (IMPACT ANCHOR)
The closest instance dominates the foreground:
• captured mid-air in a dynamic jumping attack pose

• limbs extended with directional force

• weapon leading the motion
This figure acts as the visual entry point into the scene
🎥 Camera & Perspective (PRESSURE SHOT)
Ultra-low ground-level camera, almost touching wet terrain

18–24mm close-lens perspective
• foreground character enlarged by proximity

• army recedes diagonally into depth

• leader visible in mid/deep plane

• slight horizon tilt for instability

• some units cropped at frame edges
Viewer feels inside the charge
🔍 Depth of Field (MANDATORY)
Extremely shallow depth of field
• foreground hero = razor sharp

• nearby units slightly softened

• leader readable but partially diffused

• distant army dissolves into rain and haze
No full-frame clarity
💡 Lighting Doctrine (STORM LIGHT)
Hard directional back/side light cutting through rain
• strong rim light outlining silhouettes

• rain streaks illuminated as sharp lines

• deep shadow poc
translatedContent:
一张电影级微距玩具摄影场景，描绘了数十个与上传参考角色完全相同的豆子大小的个体，在暴雨中以部分破碎的军事阵型向前冲锋，由一名位于画面深处、骑着奇幻坐骑的指挥官带领。ar 16:9

🧬 相似度完整性（关键）
所有个体必须精确保留：

• 比例

• 眼睛形状、间距、风格化

• 轮廓

• 材质特征
禁止重新设计。禁止添加特征。禁止面部更改。

所有士兵都是同一角色的相同个体。

⚔️ 场景概念与运动结构
军队从阵型过渡到全面冲锋：

• 前排进入激进的运动状态

• 中排在几毫秒后做出反应

• 后排仍保持部分阵型
运动像波浪一样在军队中蔓延
每个单位的奔跑动作都有受控的差异：

• 不同的步幅时机和身体角度

• 没有完全相同的姿势

• 所有动作均指向前方
武器：

• 每个单位携带一件超大型中世纪风格武器

• 设计各异但遵循统一的视觉语言

• 微弱的受控光效，绝不喧宾夺主

• 不得遮挡角色特征

🐉 指挥官与坐骑（指挥层）
一名指挥官出现在画面深处，位于阵型上方：

• 位于三分法轴线的偏心位置

• 在雨雾中呈现部分剪影

• 通过比例和位置与士兵明显区分
坐骑设计逻辑（关键）：

• 源自角色的材质和世界观语言

• 不进行字面意义上的克隆或服装模仿

• 在形态、纹理和装饰上保持微妙的和谐
姿势：

• 坐骑向前冲刺，穿透雨幕

• 指挥官姿态稳定受控，不过分夸张

• 展现出权威感，而非混乱的动态
指挥官已经先行移动。

军队正在追赶。

🪂 前景主角（视觉锚点）
最近的个体占据前景：

• 捕捉到半空中动态跳跃攻击的姿势

• 四肢伸展，带有方向性力量

• 武器引导动作方向

title: Nano Banana Pro 四格漫画提示词：时间停止喜剧
description: 一份详细的多分镜提示词，用于指导 Nano Banana Pro 生成灰度垂直四格浪漫喜剧漫画，讲述一名拥有时间停止能力的男子的故事，重点关注特定场景、角色表情以及日语对话。
content:
形式：縦4コマのグレースケール漫画
ジャンル：現代ラブコメ
絵柄：青年漫画、表情豊か
セリフ：吹き出しは日本語

1コマ目
シーン：
学生服の男の子が拳を握り、ドヤ顔でキラキラしたオーラを出している。
背景にキラキラ、効果線
吹き出しセリフ（日本語）：
「時間停止能力を手に入れたぞ！これで大好きなあの子と…！」

2コマ目
シーン：回想シーン、セリフなし、キラキラ演出

コマの中が3つくらいの小さな回想カットになっている。
・セーラー服の同級生の女の子に告白しているシーン（頬を赤らめている）
・大学時代、二人でデートしているシーン（私服で手をつないで笑顔）
・結婚式のシーン（ウェディングドレスとタキシード、横にペットの犬、祝福の紙吹雪）

全体がふわふわした光、ハートや花のトーン、キラキラ。
セリフなし。

3コマ目
シーン：新居のリビング、夜、落ち着いた雰囲気
大人になった男がソファに前のめりで座って真剣な顔、緊張した姿勢。顔の前で両手を組んだポーズ
生活感あるリビング（テーブル、カーテン、観葉植物など）。
吹き出しセリフ（日本語）：
「実は僕、時間停止能力があって、君と時間停止プレイしたいんだ」
男はめちゃくちゃ真剣

4コマ目
シーン：妻がツッコミ顔で立ち上がる
妻がびっくり顔で鋭いツッコミ、背景に衝撃の雷
後ろで犬が無邪気に「ハッハッ」と口を開けて笑顔、首をかしげて「？」マークが浮かんでいる。
吹き出しセリフ（日本語）：
「ここまで持ち込めたならもう必要なくない！？」
犬の横に小さく「？」。
translatedContent:
格式：垂直四格灰度漫画
类型：现代浪漫喜剧
艺术风格：青年漫画，表情生动
对话：日语对话气泡

第一格
场景：
一名身穿校服的男生握紧拳头，露出得意的表情，周身环绕着闪闪发光的氛围。
背景带有闪光和效果线
对话气泡（日语）：
“我获得了停止时间的能力！现在我终于能和我心爱的女孩在一起了……！”

第二格
场景：回忆片段，无对话，带有闪光效果
此分镜包含约三个小型的回忆切片。
・向身穿水手服的女同学告白的场景（脸颊泛红）
・大学约会的场景（便装，牵手，微笑）
・婚礼场景（婚纱和燕尾服，身边有宠物狗，纸屑纷飞）

整体光线柔和，带有爱心和花朵色调，闪闪发光。
无对话。

第三格
场景：新家的客厅，夜晚，氛围平静
成年后的男子身体前倾坐在沙发上，表情严肃，姿势紧绷。双手在脸前交握。
生活气息浓厚的客厅（桌子、窗帘、室内植物等）。
对话气泡（日语）：
“其实，我拥有停止时间的能力，我想和你玩时间停止的游戏。”
男子表情极其严肃。

第四格
场景：妻子站起身，露出犀利的吐槽表情
妻子一脸惊讶并进行犀利吐槽，背景带有震惊的闪电效果。
身后的狗天真地张着嘴微笑，歪着头，头顶浮现出一个“？”标记。
对话气泡（日语）：
“既然都已经走到这一步了，根本就不需要那种东西了吧！？”
狗的旁边有一个小小的“？”。

title: M DSLR 相机拆解与组装可视化
description: 为 Nano Banana 2 设计的两组不同图像提示词。第一组生成相机的拆解视图，第二组生成悬浮在空中并带有技术 UI 注释的高端相机产品可视化效果。第三组为 Kling AI 的动态提示词，此处已排除。
content:
Image Prompt 1: Clearly separate all components with visible spacing. Move the lens forward and split it into several segments. Separate the camera body into three sections: upper section moves upward, left section moves left, right section moves right. Use elements present on the assembled camera, add electronic parts inside. No annotations.

Image Prompt 2: Create a realistic high-end product visualization of a fully assembled M DSLR camera with detachable lens floating slightly in the air. The device has a premium matte black body with subtle metallic details and engraved M branding. Background is a softly blurred modern tech environment with depth of field and subtle motion blur, no people visible. Cinematic studio lighting with realistic reflections and premium product rendering. Around the camera appear five minimalist technical UI annotations with thin lines pointing to components. Each annotation sits inside a small semi-transparent glass UI panel with soft glow and subtle cyan edge lighting, improving readability. Clean modern sans-serif typography.

Annotations:

24MP CMOS Sensor
4K Video Recording
Interchangeable Lens Mount
Fast Hybrid Autofocus
Optical Image Stabilization
translatedContent:
图像提示词 1：清晰分离所有组件并留出可见间距。将镜头向前移动并拆分为多个部分。将相机机身分为三个部分：上部向上移动，左侧向左移动，右侧向右移动。使用组装相机上现有的元素，并在内部添加电子元件。无需注释。

图像提示词 2：创作一张逼真的高端产品可视化图像，展示一台完全组装好的 M DSLR 相机，可拆卸镜头悬浮在半空中。设备采用优质哑光黑色机身，带有精致的金属细节和雕刻的 M 品牌标识。背景为柔和模糊的现代科技环境，具有景深和细微的运动模糊效果，画面中无人。采用电影级摄影棚灯光，呈现逼真的反射和高端产品渲染效果。相机周围出现五个极简主义技术 UI 注释，用细线指向各个组件。每个注释位于一个小型的半透明玻璃 UI 面板内，带有柔和的光晕和细微的青色边缘光，以提高可读性。采用简洁的现代无衬线字体。

注释：

24MP CMOS 传感器
4K 视频录制
可更换镜头卡口
快速混合自动对焦
光学图像防抖

She has natural, smooth skin with visible pores and subtle imperfections, blue eyes that are expressive and softly reflective under golden hour light, and long, voluminous, smooth flowing hair that falls naturally across the face, partially obscuring facial features in all frames. She wears light, minimal, romantic makeup with soft blush, subtle highlighter, natural lips, and lightly defined eyes. She wears a minimalist strappy top in soft, slightly textured fabric with natural folds, in muted neutral tones of beige, cream, and soft taupe. A silver ear cuff is visible. The setting is an intimate home bedroom with a soft bed featuring neutral-toned sheets and a plush pillow supporting her upper body, with slightly wrinkled fabric for realism. Golden hour sunlight enters from a side window, creating soft, directional, warm light with streaks across face and body, producing muted golden hues with gentle contrast. The atmosphere is romantic, intimate, and calm with muted palette, soft highlights, subdued shadows, and visible film grain for cinematic texture. Use cinematic, editorial photography style with a 50mm prime lens, shallow depth of field with soft background blur, sharp focus on key facial features in each frame, fine film grain, and soft highlight roll-off with no harsh clipping. TOP FRAME: Close-up portrait in first-person selfie perspective, lying on bed propped up by pillow, head slightly turned sideways toward camera, soft romantic introspective gaze, a streak of golden sunlight crosses her face diagonally, silver ear cuff visible, hair partially covering face, eyes softly engaged with camera, tight face crop with slight shoulder visibility. CENTER FRAME: Extreme close-up of lips, hand gently brushing over lips with soft, slow, sensual but subtle motion, natural lip texture, soft light reflecting on lips, fingers partially in frame with natural positioning, hair strands crossing frame slightly, soft golden highlights with muted shadows, sharp focus on lips with shallow depth of field. BOTTOM FRAME: Close-up of eyes from side angle, same bed position, head tilted back slightly, side profile focusing on eyes, golden sunlight streak illuminating the eyes directly, blue eyes glowing under sunlight, hair partially obscuring one eye, soft shadow gradients across face, sharp focus on eyes with blurred background. Style: Romantic cinematic editorial with influences from film photography, luxury fashion editorials, and intimate lifestyle portraiture. Color palette: muted warm tones, soft beige, gold, cream, and subtle shadows. Post-processing: visible analog film grain, low to medium contrast, slightly desaturated, soft bloom effect on highlights, lifted shadows for softness. No anime or illustration, strictly photorealistic. Facial identity must remain identical across all frames. Avoid over-smoothing, preserve skin texture. Three distinct frames clearly separated but visually cohesive.
translatedContent:

场景设定在一个私密的居家卧室，一张柔软的床上铺着中性色调的床单，一个毛绒枕头支撑着她的上半身，略带褶皱的织物增加了真实感。黄金时段的阳光从侧窗射入，营造出柔和、有方向性的暖光，光束掠过脸部和身体，产生柔和的金色调和轻微的对比。氛围浪漫、私密、宁静，色调柔和，高光柔和，阴影内敛，可见胶片颗粒，营造电影般的质感。采用电影感、杂志编辑风格的摄影，使用 50mm 定焦镜头，浅景深，背景柔和虚化，每个画框中关键面部特征清晰对焦，精细的胶片颗粒，柔和的高光过渡，无生硬的过曝。

**顶部画框：** 第一人称自拍视角下的特写肖像，躺在床上，枕头支撑着，头部略微侧向镜头，柔和、浪漫、内省的凝视，一束金色阳光斜穿过她的脸庞，银色耳骨夹可见，头发部分遮盖脸部，眼睛柔和地与镜头互动，脸部特写，略可见肩膀。

**中部画框：** 嘴唇的超特写，手指以柔和、缓慢、感性而微妙的动作轻抚嘴唇，自然的唇部纹理，柔和的光线反射在嘴唇上，手指部分入画，姿态自然，几缕发丝略微穿过画面，柔和的金色高光与内敛的阴影，嘴唇清晰对焦，景深较浅。

**底部画框：** 侧面角度的眼睛特写，相同的卧姿，头部略微后仰，侧脸特写，聚焦于眼睛，金色阳光束直接照亮眼睛，蓝色的眼睛在阳光下闪耀，头发部分遮挡一只眼睛，脸部柔和的阴影渐变，眼睛清晰对焦，背景虚化。

**风格：** 浪漫电影感编辑风格，融合了胶片摄影、奢华时尚杂志和私密生活肖像的元素。
**色彩：** 柔和的暖色调，包括柔和的米色、金色、奶油色和细微的阴影。
**后期处理：** 可见模拟胶片颗粒，低到中等对比度，轻微去饱和，高光处有柔和的光晕效果，提亮阴影以增加柔和度。非动漫或插画风格，严格写实。面部特征在所有画框中必须保持一致。避免过度平滑，保留皮肤纹理。三个独立的画框清晰分隔，但视觉上保持连贯。

title: 带 面部参考 的 超逼真 抓拍照片 提示词
description: 这是一个针对 Gemini Nano Banana 的详细提示词，要求生成一张超现实、超清晰的年轻女性照片，姿势自然，且背对镜头。提示词中指定使用一张附带的参考图片来确定角色的外貌，并详细说明了服装、光线和相机设置 (iPhone 15 Pro, ISO 50, f/1.8)。
content:
Create image: Use the attached reference image as a visual guide for the character’s appearance. Preserve key visual traits such as facial structure and overall proportions, while allowing small natural variations typical of real photography. The generated subject should clearly resemble the reference while remaining a natural photographic interpretation.
Aspect Ratio: 3:4.
A hyper-realistic, ultra-sharp photograph taken on an iPhone 15 Pro, ISO 50, f/1.8, capturing a young woman in a candid, mid-moment pose. She is angled 70 degrees away from the camera in a side profile, her weight shifted onto one hip with her spine naturally curved. Her left arm is bent at an acute angle, hand running through long, voluminous espresso-colored mermaid waves, while her right hand rests lightly on a wooden ledge. Her expression is serene yet playful, featuring a soft gaze with half-lidded eyes and a subtle micro-smirk. Her "clean girl" makeup includes a sharp flick of brown liner and a dewy glass-skin finish. She wears a cream-colored open-knit crochet two-piece: a halter top with corded ties and matching high-waisted shorts featuring prominent silk-satin side bows. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused front-side lighting, rendered with digital clarity and incredible sharpness from the fabric textures to the minimalist interior background, devoid of bokeh and showcasing healthy skin radiance with visible pores
translatedContent:
生成图像：请以随附的参考图像作为人物外观的视觉指导。保留面部结构和整体比例等关键视觉特征，同时允许真实摄影中常见的小幅自然变化。生成的主体应清晰地与参考图像相似，并保持自然的摄影诠释。
宽高比：3:4。
一张使用 iPhone 15 Pro 拍摄的超现实、超清晰照片，ISO 50，f/1.8，捕捉到一位年轻女性在自然、瞬间的姿态。她以 70 度角侧向镜头，呈侧面轮廓，重心移向一侧臀部，脊柱自然弯曲。她的左臂呈锐角弯曲，手指穿过浓密蓬松的意式浓缩咖啡色美人鱼波浪长发，而她的右手则轻轻搭在一个木制壁架上。她的表情宁静而俏皮，眼神柔和，半闭着眼睛，带着一丝不易察觉的微笑。她的“清纯女孩”妆容包括一道利落的棕色眼线和水润的玻璃肌效果。她穿着一套米色镂空针织钩编两件套：一件带绳索系带的吊带上衣，以及一条配套的、带有醒目丝缎侧边蝴蝶结的高腰短裤。场景由柔和、漫射的前侧光照明，呈现出数字般的清晰度和令人难以置信的锐度，从织物纹理到极简主义的室内背景都纤毫毕现，没有散景，并展现出健康的皮肤光泽，毛孔清晰可见。

content: Create a realistic cinematic photo of a person using the face from the uploaded image. The person is standing in a clean, minimalist studio with a completely plain background (black, white, or soft grey). A single strong spotlight from above falls directly on the person, creating sharp shadows and a dramatic high-contrast look. The rest of the scene fades into darkness, keeping full focus on the subject. The camera angle is slightly low and centered, giving a powerful and premium feel. The person is wearing a stylish, minimal outfit such as a fitted t-shirt or shirt, tailored pants, and clean sneakers or shoes. Their pose is confident and calm, with natural body posture. Cinematic lighting, sharp shadows, luxury brand style, ultra realistic photography, high detail, professional fashion shoot look.

title: 四格漫画：奇幻小巷壁咚
description: 一个详细的、多格提示，用于生成日式四格漫画 (yonkoma)，描绘一个粗犷的男人和一位美丽的女性英雄，在一个黑暗奇幻的巷道场景中，重点突出夸张的表情以及每个画格的特定对话和构图。
content:
形式：日本語の4コマ漫画、縦4段、グレースケール、青年漫画、表情大げさ。
舞台：ファンタジー世界、スラムの路地裏、薄暗い雰囲気、石畳と汚れた壁、ゴミや樽が置かれている

【キャラクター設定】
・粗野な男：冒険者崩れのアウトロー、顔に傷、無精ひげ、ボロい革装備、ガラが悪い醜男
・女勇者：美しい女性、整った顔立ち、凛とした目、清潔感のある軽鎧または勇者風装備、強気な表情

【1コマ目】
構図：路地裏、粗野な男が女勇者を壁に押し付ける（壁ドン）
右側に立つ男はニヤニヤ、左側の壁に追い詰められた女勇者は悔しそうな表情
セリフ：
粗野な男「勇者サマもずいぶんとしおらしくなったじゃねぇか」
女勇者「くっ…ゲスが……」

【2コマ目】
構図：壁ドンポーズのまま、ややアップ、右側の男が余裕の笑み、左側の女勇者は睨み返す
セリフ：
粗野な男「随分と物好きな勇者サマだなぁ…オレみたいな醜男に惚れちまうなんてよ」
女勇者「私が変態のような言い草は辞めてもらおう！」

【3コマ目】
構図：真顔女勇者がド正面アップ
セリフ：
女勇者「お前は見た目も性格もカスだが、ブツだけは極上だ。自分の能力に自覚を持ったほうがいい」
真顔で女勇者の手はサムズアップ

【4コマ目】
構図：男の上半身、目を逸らし、顔が赤くなり混乱しながらときめく。頭に手をあてモジモジしている
背景は路地裏。「ドキドキ」などの描き文字効果。
セリフ：
粗野な男「えっあっハイ……ありがとうございます……」
translatedContent:
格式：日式四格漫画，四层垂直分格，灰度，青年漫画，表情夸张。
场景：奇幻世界，贫民窟小巷，昏暗氛围，鹅卵石地面和脏污的墙壁，周围堆放着垃圾和木桶。

[人物设定]
・粗犷男子：亡命之徒，曾是失败的冒险者，刀疤脸，留着胡茬，身穿破旧皮甲，丑陋且脾气暴躁。
・女英雄：美丽的女性，五官精致，眼神凛然，身着干净的轻甲或英雄式装备，神情坚毅。

[分格 1]
构图：小巷中，粗犷男子将女英雄壁咚在墙上。右侧的男子露出坏笑，左侧被逼到墙角的女英雄则神情不甘。
对话：
粗犷男子：“哟，哟，看看勇者大人变得多么乖巧啊。”
女英雄：“唔... 你这人渣...”

[分格 2]
构图：画面保持着壁咚的姿势并略微拉近，右侧的男子露出自信的笑容，女英雄则回瞪着他。
对话：
粗犷男子：“勇者大人你可真是个怪人啊... 竟然会看上我这种丑男。”
女英雄：“别再暗示我是个变态了！”

[分格 3]
构图：女英雄的严肃表情，超级特写，正面视角。
对话：
女英雄：“你的长相和性格都烂透了，但你的‘那方面’却很棒。你应该清楚自己的实力。”
女英雄一脸严肃地竖起大拇指。

[分格 4]
构图：男子上半身，眼神飘忽，脸涨得通红，困惑又慌乱。他用手挠着头，显得有些局促不安。背景是小巷。拟声词效果，如“Doki Doki”（心跳声）。
对话：
粗犷男子：“欸，啊，嗯... 非常感谢...”

title: 自封袋中的收藏卡微距摄影提示词
description: 为 Nano Banana 2 设计的一个提示，旨在将个人资料截图变成一张装在透明拉链袋里的逼真收藏卡，采用微距镜头视角，景深较浅，并辅以戏剧性的定向照明，以突出纹理和细节。
content:
A photorealistic hand holding a transparent zip bag containing a realistic collectible card.

The card has exactly the same layout as shown in the attached screenshot. The header image at the top of the card is displayed as-is, without any transparency effects.

Use true macro lens perspective (90mm–120mm macro lens look) with very shallow depth of field. Only a thin slice of the object should be in sharp focus while the rest fades into smooth blur (bokeh). The image should emphasize fine surface details, micro textures, reflections, scratches, fibers, or material structure. Lighting should be directional and dramatic, coming from one side to reveal texture and shape. Use deep shadows and controlled highlights so the object appears sculptural and cinematic.
translatedContent:
一只超写实的手，握着一个透明的自封袋，里面装着一张逼真的收藏卡。

该卡片的布局与随附截图中所示的完全一致。卡片顶部的标题图片保持原样显示，不带任何透明效果。

采用真实的微距镜头视角 (90mm – 120mm 微距镜头效果)，景深极浅。只有物体的一小部分处于清晰对焦状态，其余部分则平滑地虚化 (散景效果)。图像应强调精细的表面细节、微观纹理、反射、划痕、纤维或材料结构。光线应具有方向性且富有戏剧性，从一侧照射，以展现纹理和形状。运用深邃的阴影和受控的高光，使物体呈现出雕塑感和电影感。

content: Create Ultra-realistic photography, 8k UHD, ultra-detail, editorial grade, medium-full shot of a 25-year-old curvy and gorgeous Indonesian woman with long messy hair and striking blue eyes. Maintain 1:1 anatomical accuracy for the face and torso; do not alter the skeletal frame or chest proportions from the original identity. She is wearing an flowy drape artsy plunging v-neck camisole crop top with eclectic layered bohemian accessories, a short skirts, drape fabric. Warm golden hour lighting, perfect catchlights in the eyes, glowing skin. She is leaning in front of an old, neglected and rusty locomotive. Background is a beautiful bokeh of an abandoned train yard. Small embossed bright white duck footprint in the bottom-left area, exactly 6% from left frame and 6% from bottom frame, not touching the border. Cinematic lighting, highly detailed, sharp focus. --ar 1:2
translatedContent: 创建极致写实摄影，8K 超高清，超细节，杂志级，中景全身照：一位 25 岁、身材丰腴、容貌艳丽的印度尼西亚女性，留着凌乱的长发和迷人的蓝眼睛。保持面部和躯干 1:1 的解剖学精确度；不要改变原始身份的骨骼结构或胸部比例。她穿着一件飘逸、垂坠感十足、艺术风格的深 V 领吊带短上衣，搭配波西米亚风格的混搭叠戴配饰，一条短裙，面料具有垂坠感。温暖的黄金时段光线，眼睛里有完美眼神光，肌肤光泽透亮。她倚靠在一辆废弃、生锈的旧火车头前。背景是废弃火车场美丽的虚化效果。在左下角区域有一个浮雕般的亮白色小鸭子脚印，距离画面左侧 6%、距离画面底部 6%，不接触边框。电影级光照，高度细节，锐利对焦。--ar 1:2

title: AI GPU 集群的技术蓝图
description: 一个高度详细的提示，用于让 Gemini Nano Banana Pro 生成一张未来主义的、电影般的图像，描绘一张技术蓝图在抛光黄铜绘图桌上转变为一个逼真的、自组装的 AI GPU 集群，并强调技术细节、光照和构图。
content:
A detailed technical blueprint of a high-performance AI GPU cluster placed on a polished brass drafting table, with a photorealistic miniature AI server system self-assembling from it — multiple GPU accelerator units (sleek black and metallic modules with neon green accents) rising from the dimension lines, high-speed interconnect bridges threading through the tolerance annotations, and dense compute nodes forming from the grid layout.

Stacks of GPU cards slide into server chassis above the parts list, each unit locking in with precision. NVLink-style connectors and high-bandwidth interconnects assemble seamlessly between GPUs, forming a powerful parallel compute network. Rack-mounted AI servers emerge vertically, with layered compute blades building upward in perfect alignment.

A liquid cooling system forms from exploded-diagram callouts — transparent cooling pipes with glowing coolant flowing through them, cold plates attaching to GPUs, and radiators assembling with high-performance fans. Heat dissipation fins and airflow channels dynamically shape around the system.

A tiny engineer in futuristic protective gear stands on a GPU module inspecting circuits with a holographic diagnostic interface, while another miniature technician connects high-speed data cables into a switch unit. Fiber optic lines glow faintly, representing active data transfer.

Functional details illuminate — GPU core lights pulsing softly, status LEDs blinking in synchronized patterns, data streams visualized as glowing lines moving between nodes, and monitoring panels activating during assembly.

Signature tools of the trade — precision screwdriver, thermal paste applicator, anti-static tools, fiber connectors, and a digital diagnostic tablet — rest across the blueprint’s title block, partially integrated into the scene.

All elements grow organically from the blueprint like a 3D mechanical diorama — circuit traces rising from printed schematics, GPU modules emerging from drawn outlines, cables threading through pencil grid lines. Seamless transformation from 2D blueprint into a fully operational AI infrastructure.

LIGHTING:
Soft studio lighting combined with strong neon green and cool blue glows from GPUs and data pathways. Subtle reflections from the brass surface and volumetric light enhancing depth.

CAMERA & LENS:
Shot on a full-frame camera, 35mm lens. Slight low-angle perspective to emphasize scale and power. Cinematic depth of field with focus on central GPU cluster.

COMPOSITION:
Vertical 2:3 format. Central stacked GPU cluster rising upward with symmetrical balance. Clean negative space around edges with layered depth.

STYLE & MOOD:
Futuristic, cinematic, high-end AI infrastructure aesthetic inspired by NVIDIA design language. Powerful, clean, and cutting-edge.

DETAILS:
Ultra-detailed textures — matte black metal, glowing accents, micro circuitry, cooling liquid reflections, cable braiding, LED indicators. 8K resolution, HDR,
translatedContent:
一张高性能 AI GPU 集群的详细技术蓝图，放置在抛光的黄铜绘图桌上，一个照片般逼真的微型 AI 服务器系统正从中自行组装——多个 GPU 加速单元（光滑的黑色金属模块，带有霓虹绿点缀）从尺寸标注线中升起，高速互连桥穿过公差标注，密集的计算节点从网格布局中形成。

一叠叠 GPU 卡滑入零件清单上方的服务器机箱，每个单元都精确锁定。NVLink 风格的连接器和高带宽互连在 GPU 之间无缝组装，形成强大的并行计算网络。机架式 AI 服务器垂直出现，分层计算刀片完美对齐地向上构建。

一个液体冷却系统从爆炸图标注中形成——透明冷却管道，其中流淌着发光的冷却液，冷却板连接到 GPU，散热器与高性能风扇组装。散热片和气流通道动态地围绕系统成形。

一位身穿未来主义防护装备的微型工程师站在一个 GPU 模块上，使用全息诊断界面检查电路，而另一位微型技术员则将高速数据线连接到交换机单元。光纤线路发出微弱的光芒，代表着活跃的数据传输。

功能细节被点亮——GPU 核心灯柔和地跳动，状态 LED 以同步模式闪烁，数据流被可视化为在节点之间移动的发光线条，监控面板在组装过程中激活。

行业标志性工具——精密螺丝刀、导热膏涂抹器、防静电工具、光纤连接器和数字诊断平板电脑——放置在蓝图的标题栏上，部分融入场景。

所有元素都从蓝图中自然生长，就像一个 3D 机械立体模型——电路走线从印刷原理图中升起，GPU 模块从绘制的轮廓中浮现，电缆穿过铅笔网格线。从 2D 蓝图到完全运行的 AI 基础设施的无缝转变。

**灯光：**
柔和的摄影棚灯光，结合了 GPU 和数据路径发出的强烈霓虹绿和冷蓝色光芒。黄铜表面微妙的反射和体积光增强了深度。

**相机与镜头：**
使用全画幅相机，35 毫米镜头拍摄。略微低角度视角，以强调规模和力量。电影般的景深，焦点集中在中央 GPU 集群。

**构图：**
垂直 2:3 构图。中央堆叠的 GPU 集群向上升起，呈现对称平衡。边缘周围干净的负空间，具有分层深度。

**风格与氛围：**
未来主义、电影感、高端 AI 基础设施美学，灵感来源于 NVIDIA 的设计语言。强大、简洁、前沿。

**细节：**
超高细节纹理——哑光黑色金属、发光点缀、微型电路、冷却液反射、电缆编织、LED 指示灯。8K 分辨率，HDR。

title: 电影级 3D 玩具角色演变序列提示词
description: 一个高度结构化的提示，针对 Gemini Nano Banana，旨在生成一张电影级的 16:9 图像，展示一个 3D 玩具角色跨越 6-8 个阶段的持续演变，强调绝对的形象完整性、对角线构图、低角度视角以及渐进式光照/景深。
content:
A cinematic evolution sequence of the 3d toy character shown as multiple identical instances progressing from primitive to fully realized form across a single frame.
🔒 LIKENESS INTEGRITY (ABSOLUTE PRIORITY)

All instances must preserve exactly:

• proportions

• eye shape, spacing, stylization

• silhouette

• material identity
No redesign. No added features. No anatomy change. Only pose progression is allowed.
🧠 EVOLUTION STRUCTURE (MANDATORY)

The character appears repeated in a left-to-right progression of 6–8 stages:

• earliest stage: crouched, compressed, almost animalistic or inactive

• mid stages: gradual spine lift, awareness, balance emerging

• final stage: fully upright, confident forward motion
Each stage must feel like a natural transformation, not separate poses.

Motion must read as a continuous evolution.
🎥 CAMERA & PERSPECTIVE

Low-angle cinematic shot, slightly below mid-body height of the final character

Shot with a 28–35mm lens to create subtle perspective compression and depth

Camera positioned closer to the final evolved character, making it dominant in frame

The earliest forms recede into the background along a diagonal progression
⚖️ COMPOSITION (CRITICAL)

Diagonal layout from back-left (primitive) → front-right (evolved)

Foreground dominated by the final form, partially cropped for tension

Earlier stages progressively smaller and more compressed into depth

No centered symmetry
🎯 DEPTH OF FIELD (MANDATORY)

Primary focal plane locked on the most evolved character

Mid stages slightly softer

Earliest stages fall into progressive blur
No full-frame sharpness
💡 LIGHTING

Strong directional light from the side or rear

Rim light increases progressively across evolution stages

Primitive forms sit more in shadow

Final form is clearly defined with sculptural light separation
🌫 ATMOSPHERE

Subtle haze or volumetric light to enhance depth layering

Light falloff increases toward background

Optional faint dust or particles to create dimensional space
🎨 COLOR CONTROL

Primitive stages slightly desaturated and darker

Color richness increases toward the final evolved form

Controlled contrast, no oversaturation
🧱 SURFACE & MATERIAL

Maintain exact original material identity

Enhance micro-detail only on the focal character

No texture reinterpretation
🔥 EMOTION

Inevitable transformation

From instinct → awareness → dominance

The final character feels like the destination of a journey
🚫 NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS

No random poses

No redesign

No symmetry

No flat lighting

No full-body sharpness everywhere

No equal importance across all stages
Aspect Ratio: ar 16:9

一个 3D 玩具角色的电影般演变序列，以多个相同实例的形式呈现，在单个画面中从原始形态演变为完全成熟的形态。

所有实例必须精确保持：

• 比例

• 材质特征
不得重新设计。不得添加新特征。不得改变解剖结构。只允许姿态演变。
🧠 演变结构（强制要求）

角色以 6–8 个阶段的从左到右演变序列重复出现：

• 最早阶段：蹲伏、紧缩，几乎呈动物性或不活跃状态

• 中间阶段：脊柱逐渐抬起，意识和平衡感显现

• 最终阶段：完全直立，自信地向前移动
每个阶段都必须感觉是自然的转变，而非独立的姿态。

动作必须呈现为连续的演变。
🎥 摄像机与透视

低角度电影镜头，略低于最终角色的身体中部高度

摄像机更靠近最终演变的角色，使其在画面中占据主导地位

最早的形态沿对角线方向演进，退入背景
⚖️ 构图（关键）

对角线布局，从左后方（原始）→ 右前方（演变）

前景由最终形态主导，部分裁剪以营造张力

较早的阶段逐渐变小，并更深地压缩到景深中

无中心对称

主要焦平面锁定在最演变的角色上

中间阶段略微柔和

最早阶段逐渐模糊
无全画面锐度
💡 灯光

强烈定向光从侧面或后方照射

轮廓光在演变阶段中逐渐增强

原始形态更多地处于阴影中

最终形态通过雕塑般的光影分离清晰界定
🌫 氛围

微妙的薄雾或体积光，以增强深度分层

光线衰减向背景方向增加

可选的微弱灰尘或粒子，以营造空间感
🎨 色彩控制

原始阶段略微去饱和且更暗

色彩丰富度向最终演变形态增加

受控对比度，无过饱和
🧱 表面与材质

保持精确的原始材质特征

仅在焦点角色上增强微观细节

无纹理重新诠释
🔥 情感

必然的转变

从本能 → 意识 → 主导

最终角色感觉像是旅程的终点
🚫 禁止事项

无随机姿态

无重新设计

无对称

无平光

无全身各处锐度

无所有阶段同等重要性

Elongated neck, relaxed shoulders, subtle editorial asymmetry. Gentle cuddling, soft kissing, cheek contact, loving embrace, calm cat handling.

Bio-Fidelity: Micro-pores, fine vellus hair, hydrated skin.

description: 生成一张电影感、超写实的男性肖像，描绘一位卷发、留着胡须的男子。画面应具有高对比度光线、深邃阴影，并弥漫着空灵的红色烟雾和幽灵般的双重曝光效果。
content: A cinematic hyper-realistic portrait of a man with curly hair and a beard, looking intensely into the camera with his fingers pressed to his temples. He is wearing a black hoodie and a silver chain. The atmosphere is filled with ethereal red smoke and swirling mist. In the background, a faint, ghostly double exposure of his face looms, creating a sense of inner turmoil or psychic power. High-contrast lighting with deep shadows and sharp details.
translatedContent: 电影感超现实肖像，一名留着卷发和胡须的男子，眼神专注地凝视着镜头，双手手指按在太阳穴上。他穿着一件黑色连帽衫，戴着一条银色项链。氛围中弥漫着缥缈的红色烟雾和缭绕的薄雾。背景中，他面部模糊而幽灵般的双重曝光若隐若现，营造出一种内在挣扎或超自然力量的感觉。高对比度光线，伴随着深邃的阴影和锐利的细节。

title: 波普艺术漫画家立体模型提示词 适用于 Nano Banana Pro
description: 一个复杂、加权的提示词，用于 Nano Banana Pro 和 Nano Banana 2，以生成一个 2x2 的网格，其中包含传奇漫画艺术家的 3D 立体模型，渲染风格为波普艺术装置，具有夸张的漫画比例、本戴点、平光，并对写实主义施加强烈的负面权重。
content: Prompt:   `2x2 grid, do this for 4 Legendary Comic Artists (e.g. {argument name="artist names" default="Jack Kirby, Stan Lee, Moebius"})` <instructions>   input:   `Artist Name`   Anchor:   `A 3D diorama of the artist drawing at a drafting table, with a giant speech bubble with word inferred by AI, their famous superhero creations bursting out of the paper in 3D::3.5`   Morphology:   `Exaggerated comic proportions, thick black outlines on 3D objects, dynamic forced perspective::3`   Material Physics:   `Matte painted surfaces, visible Ben-Day dot textures on skin and clothes, flat primary colors::3`   Illumination:   `Flat graphic lighting, no realistic gradients, hard black shadows::1.5`   Render Stack:   `Pop-art installation photography, vibrant saturation, clean vector edges::1`   Negative:   `[Photorealism, muted colors, soft gradients, realistic skin textures, 3D clay]:: -1`
translatedContent:
提示:   `2x2 网格，为 4 位传奇漫画艺术家生成（例如：{argument name="artist names" default="Jack Kirby, Stan Lee, Moebius"}）`
 <指令>
   输入:   `艺术家姓名`
   锚点:   `艺术家在绘图桌前创作的 3D 立体模型，带有一个由 AI 推断出文字的巨大对话气泡，他们著名的超级英雄创作以 3D 形式从纸中跃出::3.5`
   形态:   `夸张的漫画比例，3D 物体上粗黑的轮廓线，动态的强制透视::3`
   材质物理:   `哑光绘制表面，皮肤和衣物上可见的本戴点（Ben-Day dot）纹理，平面原色::3`
   光照:   `平面图形光照，无真实感渐变，硬朗的黑色阴影::1.5`
   渲染堆栈:   `波普艺术装置摄影，鲜艳的饱和度，清晰的矢量边缘::1`
   负面提示:   `[写实主义、柔和色彩、柔和渐变、真实皮肤纹理、3D 黏土]:: -1`

title: 戏剧性 聚光灯 人像
description: 一个在 Google Gemini 上为 Nano Banana 2 准备的提示词，用于生成一张具有戏剧性、电影般好莱坞风格的照片。主体被置于地面上一个完美的明亮白色光圈内，强调光与深邃黑暗之间的强烈对比，营造出一种强大而富有戏剧性的视觉效果。
content: Create a highly cinematic Hollywood-style photo of a person using the face from the uploaded image. The person is standing alone in a completely dark environment, inside a perfect circle of bright white light on the ground, as if a spotlight from above is isolating them. Everything outside the circle fades into deep darkness. The camera angle is slightly low and centered, making the person look powerful and dramatic. The person stands still with a calm, confident posture, looking slightly upward. They are wearing a stylish modern outfit such as a long coat or jacket, fitted pants, and boots. Light rays from above are visible through subtle fog, creating a dramatic atmosphere. Strong contrast between light and shadow, cinematic lighting, soft haze, ultra realistic photography, epic movie-scene composition, Hollywood style.
translatedContent: 创作一张极具电影感的、好莱坞风格的照片，人物面部使用上传图片中的面部。人物独自站立在一个完全黑暗的环境中，地面上有一个完美的明亮白色光圈，仿佛上方有一束聚光灯将其独立照亮。光圈之外的一切逐渐融入深邃的黑暗。摄像机角度略低且居中，使人物看起来气势磅礴、富有戏剧性。人物静止站立，姿态沉着自信，略微仰视。他们穿着时尚的现代服装，例如长款大衣或夹克、修身长裤和靴子。上方光线透过淡淡的薄雾清晰可见，营造出戏剧性的氛围。强烈的光影对比，电影级布光，柔和的薄雾，超写实摄影，史诗般的电影场景构图，好莱坞风格。
